thread:
maria: Quick ask — can we make a 1-page 'Secure Serving: picking the right deploy mode' for next Tue webinar? Focus: security tradeoffs, SLA implications, and inbound routing play. Need a tight exec summary + 3 visual callouts.
chris: +1. Who's the audience? field sales? platform leads? CISO? need tone variants.
sanjay: Primary: platform & infra decision makers at enterprises. Secondary: product/security teams. We should call out VPC/on-prem vs dedicated vs hosted with a small decision tree.
elaine: I'll draft messaging hooks for PLG and field. Keep legal/compliance language short. Add icons for 'data residency', 'KMS/HSM', 'audit logs'.
maria: Good. Proposed outline: 1) one-liner value prop 2) security snapshot (controls, certs) 3) SLA table (latency, uptime, capacity) 4) deployment decision flow 5) next steps / CTA. Keep <400 words.
chris: Can we include an 'expected unit cost delta' callout? e.g., hosted vs dedicated ballpark numbers (range, not promises).
sanjay: We have vetted ranges in the benchmarks doc. I'll paste a short table into the draft. Also recommend a small 'routing play' — how to choose model fallback policies for availability.
maria: Here is a rough micro-copy doc: https://docs.google.com/secure-serving-1pager (edited)
elaine: I added three headline variants in the doc. My fav: "Secure, predictable inference — wherever you need it" :thumbsup:
chris: Suggest one visual: 3-column deploy modes with 3 rows: Security, SLA, Cost. Quick icons.
sanjay: Also add a 2-line engineering note about runtime optimizations + KV caching to justify latency numbers.
maria: Can someone take the lead on finalizing by Monday EOD? I'll own design handoff and enable the webinar slide.
elaine: I can finalize messaging + CTA by Mon noon.
sanjay: I'll drop the mini-benchmark numbers and decision-tree by Mon 4pm.
chris: I'll review and add the cost ranges, then sign off.
maria: deploy-bot: doc updated — version 4 uploaded by elaine
deploy-bot: File: secure-serving-1pager_v4.pdf uploaded to marketing drive
elaine: Awesome — will sync with webinar team for speaker bullets.
maria: Thanks team — aim to publish internal field-ready by Tue morning. small ask: add one customer-friendly quote if we can pull from case studies.
chris: I'll ping success for a short quote.
maria: closing note: keep language tight and avoid legalese. short bullets, bold the CTA. :rocket:
